legacy_columns.name: Architecture Description
legacy_columns.note: The audit flow is operationally described.

disagreement_records.proposed: EndoClock receives a target distinction, interval, modeled modalities, resampling operator and acquisition metadata. It checks increasingly informative observation representations, requires structural certification for an external-only verdict and permits unresolved. Reported acquisition and synthetic checks do not implement learned health-world transitions or planning.
disagreement_records.reason: The audit flow is operationally described.

legacy_columns.name: Key Findings
legacy_columns.note: Preserve reported quantities and distinguish channel exclusion/censoring from resampling loss.

disagreement_records.old: EndoClock distinguishes evidence retained in grid values, update patterns, native event timing or irreversibly lost during synchronization; this is a preprocessing audit contribution rather than a clinically validated dynamics/planning system.
disagreement_records.proposed: One acquisition contains five external PWD events during absent B-mode writes. Synthetic coarse-target AUC is 0.915; fine-target AUC is 0.524, 95% CI [0.482, 0.564]. Collapse persists over 5–240 Hz and tested probe classes. The actual example establishes a missing modeled witness, not necessarily destruction specifically caused by resampling.
disagreement_records.reason: Preserve reported quantities and distinguish channel exclusion/censoring from resampling loss.

scope_choices: Automated model review, not independent human verification or independent replication.

The current synthesis reviewed the complete supplied text and earlier image-review notes, not original page-image pixels. Supplied provenance records earlier API calls receiving all nine page images and texts.
Source path, page count and SHA-256 are supplied metadata, not newly checked filesystem/hash results.
All 128 operational feature definitions were considered. Reporting and reproducibility gaps justify reviewed_with_limits.
No machine schema validator, reference checker, graph builder, regression test, code execution or file-writing tool was run.
One de-identified acquisition is not a stated held-out actual human/clinical validation design. Synthetic evaluation supports only scoped R1, not R2.
Patient count/status, eligibility, device/site, protocol, collection timing, exact interval endpoints and native timestamp resolution are insufficiently reported.
The modeled image-stream boundary and the pose clock used for discovery are not fully reconciled. Complete channel accounting and device-rule/invariance evidence require clarification.
Occupancy and timing comparisons are untestable from one history. None does not establish equality or independence.
Synthetic sample size, targets, generator parameters, split independence, headline probe configuration, training details, repetitions, seeds and CI construction are not reported.
External-marker full recovery lacks a numerical metric and is not converted into AUC 1.0.
Sampling rates, recurrent classifier names and AUC confidence intervals do not establish forecast horizons, useful memory, world transitions or predictive calibration.
The real example demonstrates censoring and exclusion of an external channel, not necessarily destruction specifically caused by resampling a sufficient native modeled record.
Exogeneity, joint-law/conditioning, cell-functional and grid-dependence questions remain queued; conflicting formal statements are not silently reconciled.
Code release, software version, asset licenses, runtime, audit-verdict accuracy, named ethics approval and lifecycle governance are not documented sufficiently.
No reader study, prospective deployed use, clinical effectiveness or authorization is established. Cited-system capabilities are not inherited.
Evidence passages preserve contiguous supplied-source text, including extraction line breaks, hyphenation and joined tokens.
Raw legacy cells remain unchanged. Proposed corrections were not applied to a workbook or canonical graph.
